title: Report Plane — Markdown Generator
description: Generate markdown research reports traceable to experiment artifacts. Report must link to all artifacts and include risk checklist.
action: Create synapse/report/generator.py: generate_report(experiment_record, factor_spec, audit_result, backtest_result) -> str (markdown). Report must include all 10 sections from contract: title, hypothesis, data, factor definition, validation method, experiment setup, results, risk review, conclusion, next experiments. Conclusion must use format: promising/weak/rejected/inconclusive with evidence, risks, next steps. Must link to artifact files.
implementation: Create synapse/report/generator.py: generate_report() function that takes experiment, factor_spec, audit_result, backtest_result as inputs, returns markdown string
Report template: use f-strings or string.Template to build markdown sections
Risk review section: checklist of governance items (look-ahead bias, survivorship bias, transaction costs, etc.)
Artifact links: use relative paths to experiment/factor/backtest artifacts
Conclusion section: structured format with Evidence, Risks, Next steps, Human review required fields
Write test_report_generator.py: generate report from mock data, verify all sections present, verify artifact links

criteria: python -c "from synapse.report.generator import generate_report; print(generate_report(None, None, None, None))" contains '## Hypothesis' and '## Results' and '## Risk Review' and '## Conclusion'
synapse/report/generator.py conclusion contains 'promising' or 'weak' or 'rejected' or 'inconclusive'
